title: Chapter 486
text:
Now that Nagojin was free, it did not take long for him to finish off all the remaining Dark-star warriors. The protective shield was a fighting arena, and there was no way out. The surviving mercenaries dragged their injured bodies and gathered at the center of the battlefield.

Han Xiao counted the number of people. There were originally more than a hundred mercenaries, but now there were less than thirty left. He glanced at Herlous, Sylvia, the Volga brothers, and Fu Ding and heaved a sigh of relief. The survival of his officers was confirmed.

The Mech Legion was scattered in different locations, and he ordered the other mercenaries to collect all the machines. This immediately caused many mercenaries to complain.

The wind was so loud just now. God knows where your machines flew to. We just finished fighting. Don't be so overboard!

However, despite their complaints, the mercenaries still obediently did as they were told.

Although not everyone saw how Han Xiao performed when he used the Ames Character Summon Card, the mercenaries who saw this had even more respect in their eyes.

Han Xiao picked his ears and was rather annoyed.

These lousy mercenaries, complaining about just picking up things. The players are still the ones who are dedicated. As long as there is a reward, no matter how tiring it is, they can enjoy it. They are so much better than these mercenaries. I miss them so much.

Herlous walked forward and handed over Sherman's huge gun. "Spoils of war, this is for you."

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled. He grabbed the gun, glanced at it, and took off the outer shell. He observed the internal structure and nodded. "This gun is not bad."

The item introduction popped up on the interface. It was called [Tri-Core Photon Cannon]. This was a weapon that enjoyed the Cannon Master Mastery, which meant that the Cannon Master would receive additional bonuses when using it. The blueprint was Rare, so it saved him the effort of gambling for blueprints. Han Xiao happened to need a non-ordinary light energy gun. Although he was not a Cannon Master, the Mechanical Force bonuses could be used. It was just that the bonuses were not as great as a Cannon Master's.

Launcher Masters were long-range damage dealers. Launcher Masters were very popular in dungeons. They were the main tank, archer, and controller of the traditional iron triangle battle formation.

Han Xiao had also played as a Launcher in his previous life. Other than firing cannons, it was all about firing cannons. The damage output was in the hundreds, but it was too monotonous. Although firing cannons was fun, it was easy to get bored of it. Among the three classes of Mechanic, he still preferred the more flexible Mechanic.

Putting away the gun, Han Xiao looked at Sylvia. There were no injuries, but the lingering fear had not disappeared. He turned to look at Fu Ding, but found that Fu Ding was covered in blood. It seemed that he had experienced a fierce battle.

"Are you okay?" Han Xiao asked.

Chen Xing immediately became nervous. Recalling Fu Ding's usual demeanor, he hurriedly pulled out a kind smile and deliberately said in a gentle tone, "I, I'm fine. It's just that I met an enemy …"

Sylvia interrupted and said, "By the way, I saw you get knocked down with my own eyes. That enemy was much stronger than you. I was worried about you the whole way. Luckily, you're fine. How did you beat him?"

Chen Xing's smile suddenly froze. He wanted to sew Sylvia's mouth shut. Of all times to ask, why did she have to ask at this moment? She was trying to get him killed.

She coughed and said, "Er, I didn't beat him. The enemy was a Grade B Super. I was almost killed by him. You also know that I'm not very good at fighting. Luckily, a storm suddenly blew over and blew us away, saving my life."

"You're so lucky." Sylvia sighed.

No one doubted her. When it came to luck, they had always felt inferior.

"Yeah, you're so lucky."

Han Xiao sighed and slapped her heavily on the back, causing her to cough violently. '-1' damage popped up on top of her head.

Chen Xing's back was in pain. Suppressing her anger, she forced out a smile and laughed dryly. Seeing that Han Xiao did not suspect anything, she was relieved. She finally managed to fool Black Star.

Han Xiao snapped his fingers and called Nagojin over. At the same time, he held Chen Xing's shoulders tightly, making it impossible for her to escape.

Chen Xing twisted her body uncomfortably and said, "Can you let go of me?"

"Stop pretending." Han Xiao rolled his eyes. "You can't fool me."

Chen Xing immediately broke out in cold sweat. She hurriedly tried to find a loophole, but she could not figure out which part had gone wrong.

She clearly did not give herself away!

"You're mistaken. I'm Fu Ding." She forced a smile and explained.

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows and leaned close to Chen Xing's ear. "I told you, if you really escaped, you wouldn't want to meet me."

Chen Xing's heart skipped a beat.

This time, Nagojin walked over. Han Xiao patted Chen Xing's shoulder and said with a smile, "Stop struggling. There's a Grade A Super here. You can't escape. You don't want to be beaten up by him."

Chen Xing gritted his teeth and stopped pretending. He angrily said, "How did you recognize me?"

Han Xiao also had a helpless expression. The interface had already revealed her identity. He could not be fooled even if he wanted to. He could not play along and pretend that he did not see anything. He was also very desperate!

Chen Xing was at her wit's end. She could not think of any way to escape. She glared at Han Xiao fiercely. In her mind, she had already imagined a hundred ways for Han Xiao to die. She wished she could whip his corpse a hundred times herself.

She might as well give up the control of her body. It was better than being suppressed by someone else.

Fu Ding's consciousness returned. He moved his limbs, shook his head, and smiled. "I knew you would recognize me."

"You're really lucky. Even though she regained control of her body, she still did not crush your consciousness." Han Xiao was quite envious. The Luck Glow was still very strong.

Fu Ding laughed. "Actually, it was quite pleasant communicating with her. I know everything about her, and she knows everything about me. We understand each other's thoughts …"

"Congratulations on finding your soul mate. Why don't you just marry her? My mission will be completed."

Han Xiao shook his head. Suddenly, he was stunned.

Wait, could it be that I guessed right? Fu Ding's mission was the perfect completion condition. Could it be that he really became a victim?

Fu Ding pointed to his head and said helplessly, "I won't tell you how she scolded you."

Han Xiao laughed dryly, let go of his hand, and hurriedly moved away from Fu Ding. He grabbed Sylvia's hair and wiped his hands. He suddenly did not want to get close to Fu Ding.

After casually chatting for a while, he looked at the time. Ashes should be back soon. At this time, Han Xiao discovered a serious problem. Although the battle was over, the protective shield still isolated the area. If they could not leave, they could not besiege Ashes according to the plan.

This problem could only be solved by the Noriose Consortium. The Guardian had been watching not far away. Han Xiao felt that it was necessary to communicate with him.

Han Xiao and Nagojin teamed up and asked the Guardian to open the protective shield. The Guardian did not even think about it and directly rejected the request.

"There is still a Dark-star member alive. He is rushing back. If you don't open the protective shield, we can't deal with him," Nagojin said.

The Guardian was expressionless. "I know. That's why I will not open the protective shield before the enemy you mentioned leaves. You will stay here until I confirm that this matter is completely over."

"Are you trying to protect the Dark-star members?" Nagojin said angrily.

"My duty is to protect Noriose. Do you want me to open the protective shield and let you continue to destroy the city? I don't want to see anyone causing trouble in Noriose. After this matter is over, our consortium will ask Godora for compensation. "

The guardian narrowed his eyes. Not saving Anur was because he had no choice but to give up. However, that did not mean that he would stand on Godora's side. The protective shield would definitely not be opened, and that was the bottom line of the financial group's upper echelons. Furthermore, the financial group did not wish to see any more high-level combatants of DarkStar dying here.
